hebrewText: וּ/בְ/עֵ֣ת קֵ֗ץ יִתְנַגַּ֤ח עִמּ/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וְ/יִשְׂתָּעֵ֨ר עָלָ֜י/ו מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/צָּפ֗וֹן בְּ/רֶ֨כֶב֙ וּ/בְ/פָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וּ/בָ/אֳנִיּ֖וֹת רַבּ֑וֹת וּ/בָ֥א בַ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת וְ/שָׁטַ֥ף וְ/עָבָֽר

tokens.bdb: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.

tokens.bdb: an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after
to butt with the horns; figuratively, to war against
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to butt with the horns; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to butt with the horns; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to butt with the horns; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to butt with the horns; figuratively

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine)
to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear
tokens.kjv: be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)
a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
tokens.kjv: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.

tokens.bdb: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting ); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.explanation: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.explanationEn: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer
tokens.kjv: drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
tokens.kjv: alienate, alter, [idiom] at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) [phrase] proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, [phrase] raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, [phrase] shave, cause to (make) sound, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanation: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanationEn: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
